title: From an Elementary Proof of Error Representation for Hermite Quadrature to a Rediscovery of Legendre Polynomials and Rodrigues Formula
summary: We generalize two-point interpolatory Hermite quadrature to functions with available values and the first (n-1) derivatives at both end points. Armed with integration by parts in the reverse form we provide an elementary derivation of an exact error represenation of Hermite quadrature rule.
